capabilities: Show related notes, matching blocks and similar-content pairs for the current note in a side panel
Run semantic search over the vault by meaning rather than exact words
Flag paragraphs that drift from the note's title
Surface notes recent writing keeps returning to (Gravity)
Pause and resume indexing while writing
disambiguation: Not a sync or collaboration tool; "connections" here means semantic links between notes computed locally.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation requires manually copying release files into the plugins folder; no community-plugin store install is described.
intentEvidence: A similar (most popular) plugin for this problem (semantic cosine similarity) kept triggering a weird graphics bug/freeze
motivation: The author's existing similarity plugin crashed his MacBook, so he wrote a free, minimalist, fully local alternative with no data collection.
problem: Obsidian only surfaces connections you link by hand; finding notes and paragraphs related by meaning normally requires cloud AI services or manual linking.

relations.evidence: It runs on your own computer through Ollama, so your notes never leave your machine

summary: Semantic similarity panel that shows notes, blocks and title-content pairs related to the current note, using a local Ollama embedding model.
